name: Wee Faerie Camp
description_short: A three day faerie themed mini camp at the Florence Griswold Museum in Old Lyme for children in kindergarten to grade 3, 10 am to 3 pm. Each camper builds a faerie house and makes a faerie book, and wings, a t-shirt, materials and snacks are included.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations before each session's cutoff date are refunded less a $20 fee. No refunds after the cutoff.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Wee Faerie Camp #2 2026 event page. $235 per three day session, members get 10% off. Geared for students K to 3. Early drop off after 9 am can be arranged by email.

Researched by Claude from this page. Museum camp calendar for June 2026, which shows Wee Faerie Camp #2 on June 23 to 25 and #3 on June 30 to July 2 (also read on https://flogris.org/calendar/wee-faerie-camp-3-2026/2026-06-30/).
